notes.title: This base builder sits at the bottom of your screen, which means nobody knows I've been playing it during meetings
notes.notes: s someone who routinely has Rimworld on in the background, ready to be tended to the second I have a moment, dEskape immediately grabbed my attention with its premise. A base building survival game that sits at the bottom of your screen while you get on with whatever it is you'd like to get on with. Faced with an afternoon of admin, I decided I'd give it a go. Nobody tell PCG's editors... Read more.

notes.title: Build a base to escape an alien world, all while browsing the internet in this quarter-screen idler
notes.notes: Clickers, idlers, and the like exist for a reason: That reason is many of us want to do two things at a time. We want to stimulate more than one bit of our brain. I'm sure that by now you know at least one person, or are that person, who combines in some way watching shows, listening to podcasts, reading social media, and videogames at once... Read more.
